title: Implement CLI commands: cron
description:
Implement cron management CLI commands.

## Commands
- krankie cron install [--hour <0-23>]
- krankie cron uninstall
- krankie cron status

## Behavior
- install: Adds crontab entry for daily check at specified hour (default: random 2-6 AM)
- uninstall: Removes krankie entry from crontab
- status: Shows if installed, next run time

## Implementation
- Use crontab -l and crontab - for manipulation
- Log output to ~/.krankie/check.log

## Acceptance Criteria
- cron install adds valid crontab entry
- cron uninstall removes only krankie entry
- cron status accurately reports state

title: Implement CLI commands: check
description:
Implement ranking check CLI commands.

## Commands
- krankie check run [--app <app_id>] [--store <store>]
- krankie check status [--json]

## Behavior
- check run fetches rankings for all (or filtered) keywords
- Groups by store to minimize context switching
- Shows progress during check
- Logs to ~/.krankie/check.log
- Updates metadata.last_check on completion

## Acceptance Criteria
- Respects rate limiting from scraper
- Can filter by app or store
- Shows progress for long-running checks

title: Implement App Store scraper
description:
Build the scraping layer for fetching keyword rankings from App Store.

## Tasks
- Create appstore.ts for search endpoint fetching
- Create parser.ts to extract app rankings from results
- Create ratelimit.ts with delay/retry logic

## Scraping Strategy
- 2-5 second random delay between requests
- User-Agent rotation
- Platform filtering (iphone, ipad, mac, appletv, watch)
- 3 retries with exponential backoff
- Parse results to find app position (1-200)

## Acceptance Criteria
- Can fetch search results for a keyword + store
- Correctly identifies app rank in results
- Returns null for apps not in top 200
- Handles rate limiting gracefully

title: Implement database layer
description:
Create the SQLite database layer with schema and queries.

## Tasks
- Create schema.ts with table definitions (apps, keywords, rankings, metadata)
- Create migrations.ts for schema versioning
- Create queries.ts with typed query functions
- Database location: ~/.krankie/krankie.db

## Tables
- apps: id, app_id, name, developer, platform, created_at
- keywords: id, app_id (FK), keyword, store, created_at
- rankings: id, keyword_id (FK), rank, checked_at (append-only)
- metadata: key, value

## Acceptance Criteria
- Database auto-creates on first use
- All CRUD operations work
- Rankings append-only (no updates)

title: Implement CLI commands: keyword
description:

title: Implement TUI dashboard
description:
Build the Ink-based TUI dashboard for human monitoring.

## Views
1. Overview - Summary stats, top movers across all apps
2. Apps - List apps, drill into keywords per store
3. Keywords - Flat keyword list, sortable
4. History - Recent check log

## Navigation
- ←→ / Tab: Switch tabs
- ↑↓: Navigate lists
- Enter: Drill into selection
- Esc: Go back
- Tab (in app detail): Cycle stores
- r: Refresh
- q: Quit

## Display
- Color coding: green (rank up), red (rank down)
- Auto-refresh every 30 seconds
- Shows 24h and 7d rank changes

## Acceptance Criteria
- All views render correctly
- Navigation is intuitive
- Updates in real-time

title: Implement CLI commands: init, info, instructions
description:
Implement utility CLI commands.

## Commands
- krankie init - Initialize database
- krankie info - Show db path, stats
- krankie instructions [--format markdown|text|json] - Agent usage guide

## instructions output
Should include:
- Quick start workflow
- All available commands
- Tips for agent usage
- JSON format for programmatic parsing

## Acceptance Criteria
- init creates ~/.krankie/ directory and database
- info shows useful stats (app count, keyword count, last check)
- instructions is comprehensive enough for an agent to use the tool

title: Implement CLI commands: rankings
description:
Implement ranking query CLI commands.

## Commands
- krankie rankings [--app <app_id>] [--keyword <keyword>] [--store <store>] [--days <n>] [--json]
- krankie rankings movers [--days <n>] [--min-change <n>] [--json]
- krankie rankings history <keyword_id> [--days <n>] [--json]

## Acceptance Criteria
- All commands support --json
- movers shows biggest rank changes (up or down)
- history shows full time-series for a keyword
- Default --days is 7
